title: Discrete FIR Filter
text: Finite-impulse response filter, {Coefficient source} sets Source of filter coefficients, and so does the port count; {Coefficients} sets the discrete FIR filter coefficients, {Coefficients prototype} sets the prototype filter coefficients, {Filter structure} sets the hDL filter architecture Direct form, {Specify serialization factor as} sets the rule to define serial implementation Minimum number of cycles between valid input, {Number of cycles} sets the serialization requirement for input timing, {Number of multipliers} sets the serialization requirement for resource, {Optimize symmetric coefficients} sets the share multipliers for symmetric coefficients with frame-based, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling for type-casting, {Output} sets the data type of filter output, {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port, {Use HDL global reset} sets the option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset, {Coefficient multiplication} sets the coefficient multiplier implementation in hardware and {Use multiplier for +/- 1 and power of 2 coefficients} sets the special-value coefficient multiplier implementation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Input data scalar | column vector | row vector

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Source of filter coefficients Property (default) | Input port (Parallel interface) | Input port (Memory interface)

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Discrete FIR filter coefficients [0.5, 0.5] (default) | row vector | multichannel matrix

params.name: Coefficients prototype
params.values: Prototype filter coefficients [] (default) | real or complex vector

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: HDL filter architecture Direct form systolic (default) | Direct form transposed | Partly serial systolic

params.name: Specify serialization factor as
params.values: Rule to define serial implementation Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples (default) | Maximum number of multipliers

params.name: Number of cycles
params.values: Serialization requirement for input timing 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of multipliers
params.values: Serialization requirement for resource usage 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Optimize symmetric coefficients
params.values: Share multipliers for symmetric coefficients with frame-based input on (default) | off

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for type-casting the output Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow handling for type-casting the output off (default) | on

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of filter output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same word length as input |

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use HDL global reset
params.values: Option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset signal off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficient multiplication
params.values: Coefficient multiplier implementation in hardware Multiplier (default) | CSD/Factored-CSD

params.name: Use multiplier for +/- 1 and power of 2 coefficients
params.values: Special-value coefficient multiplier implementation in hardware on (default) | off
